items.title: 5.7 Archimedes ka usool aur tairna (floatation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.7 with Figs. 5.8 to 5.10 and Examples 5.2 and 5.3 (PDF 101-104).

blocks.text: Hawa bhara ghubbara pani ki satah ke neeche chhorte hi foran satah par aa jata hai; lakri ka tukra pani ke neeche chhorein to bhi yahi hota hai. Pani se bhara mug pani ke neeche halka lagta hai magar bahar nikalte hi bhari. Do hazar saal se zyada pehle Yunani scientist Archimedes ne dekha ke liquid ke andar rakhi cheez par oopar ki force lagti hai, jis se cheez ke wazan mein zahiri kami nazar aati hai; yeh oopar ki force liquid ka upthrust hai.

blocks.title: Archimedes ka usool
blocks.text: Jab koi cheez liquid mein poori ya juz-wi taur par dubai jaye to us par upthrust force lagti hai jo us ke hataye hue liquid ke wazan ke barabar hai.

Liquid mein dooba cross-sectional raqbe A aur oonchai h ka thos cylinder lein (Fig. 5.8). Farz karein h1 aur h2 satah se oopar aur neeche ki satahon ki gehraiyan hain: h2 - h1 = h ... (5.11). Agar P1 aur P2 gehraiyon h1 aur h2 par liquid ke dabao aur rho density ho to P1 = rho g h1 aur P2 = rho g h2. P1 ki wajah se liquid ki oopar lagai force F1 aur P2 ki wajah se neeche lagai force F2: F1 = P1 A = rho g h1 A aur F2 = P2 A = rho g h2 A. F1 aur F2 mukhalif satahon par lagti hain, to cylinder par khalis force F un ka farq hai, liquid ka upthrust: F2 - F1 = rho g h2 A - rho g h1 A = rho g A (h2 - h1) ... (5.12), ya upthrust = rho g A h, ya upthrust = rho g V ... (5.13). Yahan A h cylinder ka volume V hai, jo hataye liquid ke volume ke barabar hai, to rho g V hataye liquid ka wazan hai: liquid mein doobe jism par hataye liquid ke wazan ke barabar upthrust lagta hai, jo Archimedes ka usool hai. Archimedes taqreeban 287 BCE mein Sicily ke jazeere par Syracuse mein paida hua aur apna riyazi kaam chhorne se inkar par Romi sipahi ke haathon mara gaya (For Your Information).

blocks.title: Example 5.2
blocks.text: 10 cm kinare ka lakri ka cube pani mein poora dubaya jata hai. Us par pani ka upthrust nikalein. Hal: L = 10 cm = 0.1 m; V = L^3 = (0.1 m)^3 = 1 x 10^-3 m^3; rho = 1000 kg m^-3; F = ?. Archimedes ke usool se upthrust = rho g V = 1000 kg m^-3 x 9.8 m s^-2 x 1 x 10^-3 m^3 = 9.8 N.

Cheez doobti hai agar us ka wazan us par lagne wale upthrust se zyada ho; tairti hai agar us ka wazan upthrust ke barabar ya kam ho. Jab cheez fluid mein tairti hai to us par upthrust cheez ke wazan ke barabar hota hai; tairti cheez juz-wi taur par doobi ho sakti hai, aur upthrust hamesha hataye fluid ke wazan ke barabar hota hai. Yeh floatation ka usool hai: tairti cheez utna fluid hatati hai jis ka wazan cheez ke wazan ke barabar ho. Archimedes ka usool liquids ke saath gases par bhi lagta hai, aur rozmarra zindagi mein us ke bohat se istemalat hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: liquid mein dooba cylinder us ki oopar aur neeche ki satahon par dabao ki forces, gehraiyan h1 aur h2 aur upthrust ki equations ke saath. Oopar darmiyan: floatation ka usool aur chaar istemalat Example 5.3 ke saath. Oopar daen: mutawazi streamlines aur rukawat ke peechhe bhanwar, flow ki tareefon ke saath. Neeche: A1 se A2 tak tang hota pipe rangeen hisson, rate-of-flow aur continuity equations aur Example 5.4 ke saath.
blocks.caption: Archimedes ka usool, tairna, streamline flow aur equation of continuity (Figures 5.8 se 5.15 aur topics 5.7 se 5.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Doobe cylinder ki neeche ki satah par liquid ka dabao oopar ki satah se density zarb g zarb oonchai zyada hota hai, to khalis oopar ki force us liquid ka wazan hai jo cylinder hatata hai, jo Archimedes ka usool hai; jism tab tairta hai jab us ka wazan is upthrust se zyada na ho, aur tab apne wazan jitna fluid hatata hai, jo hot-air balloons, tairti lakri, jahazon aur aabdozon ki wazahat karta hai. Streamline flow mein kisi nuqte se guzarta har zarra pehle walon ka rasta leta hai aur streamlines kabhi nahi katti, jabke ek khaas speed se oopar flow bhanwaron ke saath turbulent ho jata hai; ideal fluid non-viscous, incompressible aur steady hai. Fi second kisi section se guzarta volume raqba zarb speed hai, aur chunke mass baqi rehta hai yeh hasil-e-zarb pipe ke har section par ek sa hai, to tang hota pipe flow tez karta hai.

items: Hot-air balloon (Fig. 5.9): hot-air balloons is liye uthte aur hawa mein tairte hain ke hot-air balloon ki density aas paas ki hawa se kam hai; jab balloon par buoyant force us ke wazan se zyada ho to woh uthna shuru karta hai, jo balloon mein garam hawa ki miqdar badal kar kiya jata hai.

Pani par tairta lakri ka block: barabar volume ke pani ka wazan block ke wazan se zyada hai. Floatation ke usool se jism tairta hai agar juz-wi ya poora doobne par us ka hataya pani jism ke wazan ke barabar ho.

Jahaz aur kashtiyan (Fig. 5.10a): floatation ke usool par bane, pani par musafir aur saman le jate hain; jahaz doob jaye agar musafiron aur saman samet us ka wazan pani ke upthrust se zyada ho jaye. (Brain Teaser: bhari steel ka jahaz kyun tairta hai jabke chhota patthar doobta hai? Us ka khokhla hull poora doobne se pehle apne wazan ke barabar pani hata deta hai.)

Aabdoz (submarine, Fig. 5.10b): usi usool par pani ke oopar aur neeche dono chalti hai. Yeh tairti hai jab us ke volume ke barabar pani ka wazan us ke wazan se zyada ho, jahaz ki tarah juz-wi taur par pani ki satah se oopar rehte hue. Us mein tanks hain jo samandari pani se bhare aur khali kiye ja sakte hain; tanks bharne par aabdoz ka wazan barhta hai, aur jaise hi us ka wazan upthrust se zyada ho woh ghota lagati aur pani ke neeche rehti hai; oopar aane ko tanks khali kiye jate hain.

blocks.title: Example 5.3
blocks.text: Khali meteorological balloon ka wazan 80 N hai aur yeh 10 cubic metre hydrogen se bhara jata hai. Balloon apne wazan ke ilawa kitna utha sakta hai? Hydrogen ki density 0.09 kg m^-3, hawa ki density 1.3 kg m^-3. Hal: w = 80 N, V = 10 m^3, rho1 = 0.09 kg m^-3, rho2 = 1.3 kg m^-3. Upthrust F = hatai hawa ka wazan = rho2 g V = 1.3 kg m^-3 x 9.8 m s^-2 x 10 m^3 = 127.4 N. Hydrogen ka wazan w1 = rho1 V g = 0.09 kg m^-3 x 10 m^3 x 9.8 m s^-2 = 8.82 N. Kul uthaya wazan F = w + w1 + w2; saman uthane ko kul wazan F se zyada na ho: 80 N + 8.82 N + w2 = 127.4 N, ya w2 = 38 N (38.6 N). Print ki aakhri line zyada se zyada wazan 41 N deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 600 kg m^-3 density ka 10 kg lakri ka block pani mein tairta hai; buoyant force nikalein (numerical 5.4). Patthar ka wazan hawa ke muqable pani mein kam kyun lagta hai (MCQ 5.7)?
blocks.explanation: Tairta jism apne wazan ke barabar fluid hatata hai, to buoyant force wazan ke barabar hai, 10 x 9.8 = 98 N (block 60% dooba hai). Doobe patthar par oopar ki buoyant force us ke wazan ka hissa sambhalti hai, to zahiri wazan hataye pani ke wazan jitna ghatta hai.

items: Upthrust: F2 - F1 = rho g A (h2 - h1) = rho g V = hataye liquid ka wazan (Archimedes). Tairta hai agar wazan upthrust se zyada na ho; tairta jism apne wazan ke barabar fluid hatata hai (floatation ka usool), gases ke liye bhi.
Istemalat: hot-air balloon, tairti lakri, jahaz aur kashtiyan, aabdoz (ghote ko tanks bharna). Misalein: 10 cm cube par 9.8 N; balloon taqreeban 38 N uthata hai (print 38 N aur 41 N).
